_metadata.purpose: Explicit human overrides applied on top of blind-review verdicts (scripts/unlimited/apply-overrides.mjs). A hint override can hold a passed hint out of the beta, release such a hold, or (status human_approved) record a person's decision that a hint is playable; a pair override (status hold_pair) keeps a pair out of FUTURE generation only. Boards already assembled or served, their snapshots and players' history are never touched. Every entry names who decided and why.
